Commentary.Commentary: That is it then and it is England who have taken an unassailable 2-0 lead in the three-game ODI series. There is still one game left and Bangladesh will be looking to avoid a whitewash, especially given their fantastic ODI form at home in the last few years. The 3rd and final ODI will be played on Monday, the 6th of March at the Zahur Ahmed Chowdhury Stadium in Chattogram. That game will begin at 11.30 am IST (6 am GMT) but you can catch our build-up for the game a lot sooner. Cheers!

Jos Buttler, the captain of England says that it is a fantastic series win as Bangladesh are a formidable side at home. Claims that they tried to see how they could improve from the last game and the batters contributed in this game followed by the bowlers. Mentions that the conditions they would find here are the hardest they would face as a team and from one to eleven, the players stood up which is what they strive to achieve. Ends by saying that they spoke about adapting to conditions and when they get to Chittagong they need to assess the conditions backed by some good performances by the players.

Jason Roy (132 off 124 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his sublime century. Roy says that he has played a lot of cricket in the subcontinent and he had to dig deep with his skills in this game and it came off. Adds that it was about giving himself an opportunity and wanted to make sure that he gave himself time in the middle. Says that the way Jos Buttler played it was amazing and applauds the efforts of Moeen Ali and Sam Curran to score as freely as they did on this deck. Ends by saying that he is very happy with his performance.

Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal says that he is a bit disappointed with the way they started with the ball as there was a lot in it for the spinners. Claims that they had their chances but the missed run-out opportunity cost them and gives credit to Jason Roy and Jos Buttler for their innings. Adds that it is disappointing to lose the first series at home since 2016. Mentions that when they lose it is easy to point fingers but he does not want to do that as it is a bad performance by the team and not by any individual. Explains that when you lose three wickets in the first few overs it becomes difficult to chase a huge total and they have to have a go at some time. Reckons that they did not give up and with Shakib Al Hasan they took some time but unfortunately it didn’t work out. Ends by saying that they would like to end the series on a high and that it is disappointing to lose the series but credits England for playing really well.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Tamim Iqbal won the toss and took a surprising decision to bowl first. This proved fruitful early on as they got rid of Philip Salt but from then on, things only got worse for them. Jason Roy started punishing the bowlers and the spinners seemed to be largely ineffective as well. They did get a couple of quick wickets but then Jos Buttler joined Roy in the middle and the pair put on a century stand to put England on top of the proceedings. A couple of handy cameos from Moeen Ali and Sam Curran ensured the visitors got well above the 300-run mark. Taskin Ahmed was the standout bowler for Bangladesh as he picked up three wickets and Mehidy Hasan chipped in with a couple of wickets as well. Coming to the chase, Sam Curran broke the back of the hosts early on with three quick wickets and they never really recovered despite a few decent starts by their batters.

Bangladesh will be thoroughly disappointed with the loss and more so with their approach with the bat. They had a shaky start as Litton Das got out playing a poor shot and the likes of Najmul Hossain Shanto and Mushfiqur Rahim soon followed suit. It was then a steady stand between skipper Tamim Iqbal and Shakib Al Hasan that got the scoreboard ticking but they were always behind the in the chase. Tamim fell but Shakib went on to notch up a fine half-century but got out soon after. Mahmudullah and Afif Hossain too built up a decent stand and Taskin Ahmed was able to get a few boundaries away towards the end but they couldn't even manage to cross the 200-run mark which is a worrying factor.

England had the runs on the board and all they needed was a decent start with the ball. They got that and then some as Sam Curran's early blitz had the opposition reeling at 9/3 with all three wickets going to Curran himself. After that, the Bangladeshi batters showed resilience and didn't lose a wicket till the 20th over. It was Moeen Ali who got the breakthrough and then Adil Rashid bowled a lovely spell in which he took four wickets and put the visitors within touching distance. With less than 10 overs to spare, Sam Curran came back in and soon was able to get his fourth wicket and seal the game for his side with 32 balls to go.

England have sealed a big win and also the three-game series 2-0 with a game to spare, a very clinical showing from the visitors. It is the first bilateral series loss for hosts Bangladesh at home since 2016 and guess who the last team was to defeat them? Yes, it was the same opposition, England!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sam Curran gets four wickets and England have registered a comprehensive win! Sam Curran was the one who did the initial damage with the ball and it is apt that he claims the last wicket. He bowls this on a good length and on an outside off-stump line. Taijul Islam hangs his bat out to dry and gets a faint edge towards the wicket-keeper. Jos Buttler has the easiest of catches to take behind the wicket and England have wrapped up the innings with 32 balls left and they win by 132 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in for Bangladesh.

OUT! DIRECT HIT! Some lazy bit of running from Taskin Ahmed ​​​​and a good bit of fielding from Moeen Ali! Sam Curran bowls this short and outside the off stump. Taskin Ahmed backs away to the leg side and slaps this towards cover. Moeen Ali is quick to collect the ball and aims at the non-striker's end. He gets his throw on target and Taskin Ahmed has not grounded his bat. He has to depart and England are now just one wicket away from a series win.

Is that a run-out? Looked really close on the first instance. Taskin Ahmed laces this one to the man at extra cover and sets off for the quick single. Its a good pick-up and throw from Moeen Ali there as he scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The replays show that Taskin was lazy in grounding his bat and that cost him his wicket. OUT is the signal on the big screen.
Another short ball directed at the batter. Taskin Ahmed misses his pull and gets hit on the shoulder.

Sam Curran bangs this in short and going down leg. Taskin Ahmed goes for the pull and is early into the shot. The ball hits his arm and lobs towards the keeper. Jos Buttler gets forward well and dives to hold onto the ball. They appeal for a caught behind but the umpire disagrees and Jos Buttler goes upstairs for a review. Replays show the ball has come off the forearm. Taskin Ahmed survives and England will lose a review.
A maiden! Pushed through quicker and on off stump, Taijul Islam makes yet another block.
Floated up around off, this is stroked away to cover-point.
A hint of flight as this is bowled on off stump, Taijul Islam keeps it out.
Keeps it nice and full around off, Taijul pushes it out toward cover.
Fuller now and on the stumps, Taijul Islam plays it toward mid on.
Flatter trajectory on middle and leg, blocked out.
FOUR! Another clean strike from Taskin Ahmed! Full and straight, Taskin gets the front leg out of the way and drills it to the right of the man at long on for a boundary.
Another slower one around off, this is forced off the back foot toward mid off.
Swing and a miss! Cutter, into the pitch and around off stump, Taskin Ahmed swings across the line but is well beaten.
Full and angling down leg, this is flicked away to fine leg for a single.
Finds the blockhole this time on middle and leg, Taskin digs it out to long on for one.
FOUR! Gloriously driven! Starts off with a half-volley outside off, Taskin Ahmed leans on and creams it uppishly through extra cover for a boundary.
Sam Curran (5-1-19-3) has been brought back into the attack.
Floats it up and drags back the length as well, Taijul Islam keeps it out.
Flighted once again around off, Taijul Islam strides out to defend.
Short and outside off, cut away to backward point.
Taijul Islam walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nicely bowled once again and Adil Rashid gets his fourth scalp of the game. Flights this one up, on a length and around off. It is the regular leg-break and Mehidy Hasan gets caught in two minds as he steps out. Mehidy looks to dance down and loft it over long off but ends up just checking the lofted drive. The ball is chipped down to long off where the substitute fielder Rehan Ahmed takes a simple catch. England are now just 2 wickets away from victory.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Rehan Ahmed b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Gives it more air and bowls it down leg, Taskin Ahmed slogs it away to deep backward square leg for a run.
This is full and around off, Taskin Ahmed attempts the reverse sweep but misses and gets struck on the pads.
Slower again, on a good length and around off. Taskin Ahmed just eases it behind point for a single.
Slower bumper this, pushed well outside the off stump and Taskin Ahmed can't reach it.
On a hard length and angled into the body, Taskin tucks it onto the leg side.
FOUR! Short again and angling in from around off, Taskin Ahmed stays deep and pulls it flat and hard straight back past the bowler and to the right of mid on for another boundary.
Comes from around the wicket and delivers a slower short ball around off. Taskin Ahmed looks to take it on but misses.

FOUR! Just over! This is banged in short and outside off, Taskin Ahmed backs away and slashes at it hard. Taskin ends up slapping it away flat and well in front of the man at deep cover. Philip Salt there covers a lot of ground quickly and tries to leap up and take it one-handed but only manages to get a fingertip on it. The ball goes into the fence.
Floated up, full and on middle, this is driven straight to short cover.
Shortish length, turning away from outside off, Mehidy Hasan goes back and across to cut it toward point.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, blocked out.
Floated up around leg stump and turning it away, Mehidy Hasan paddles it 'round the corner and picks up another brace.
On the stumps, kept out by Mehidy Hasan.
Loopy delivery, full and around off, Mehidy Hasan gets inside the line and laps it down to fine leg for am couple of runs.
Keeps it short and angles this one away from the left-hander, Taskin Ahmed throws his bat at it but fails to connect.

Just over! Banged in again by Saqib Mahmood over middle and leg and climbing on the batter. Taskin Ahmed looks to take it on but ends up pulling it off the sticker and just over the leaping bowler as well.
Banged in short and over leg stump, Taskin Ahmed ducks under it well.
Good length around the top of off, this is blocked out to cover.
A full toss now around middle, Taskin Ahmed whips it away in front of the man at deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Back of a length around off, this is punched away off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Taskin Ahmed walks in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT! Adil Rashid gets his third wicket and Bangladesh go further behind in this game now! Adil Rashid flights this one full and in line with stumps. Mahmudullah looks to work this leg side but he is decieved by the turn and gets a leading edge to the slip fielder. Moeen Ali takes a comfortable catch at waist height and Bangladesh have lost their seventh wicket. England has been dominant so far and will be looking to wrap up this inning at the earliest.
Commentary.Howout: c Moeen Ali b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Short again and outside the off stump. Mehidy Hasan waits deep in the crease and cuts this towards deep backward point for a single.
This is short and outside the off stump. Mehidy Hasan pushes this towards point.
This is slightly short and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah rocks back and hits this to the right of mid on for a run.

Floats this one full and outside the off stump, Mahmudullah looks to heave this into the leg side but top edge the ball. It goes towards deep mid-wicket and just about clears the fielder running back from the inner circle.
Adil Rashid bowls this short and just outside off. Mahmudullah goes back in the crease and gets square up. the ball goes off the outside edge onto the off side.
On a good length this time and outside the off pole. Mehidy Hasan blocks this towards mid one.
This is bowled back of a length and outside off. Mahmudullah whips this to deep square leg and takes a single.

A bit of luck going Mahmudullah's way! Saqib Mahmood bangs this in short and  going down leg. Mahmudullah looks to pull and gets a top edge that lands next to him on a leg side. Neither the wicket-keeper nor the bowler were able to get to it.
Delivers this in line with the stumps. Mehidy Hasan steps across the stumps and tucks this to the right of mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Mehidy Hasan defends this towards cover.
Saqib Mahmood bowls this short and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah pulls this towards deep square leg and takes a single.
This is short and pitching in line with the stumps. Mehidy Hasan goes deep in the crease and the ball spins away to beat the outside edge of his bat.
Mehidy Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust as Adil Rashid strikes and Jos Buttler takes a sharp catch behind the wicket! Adil Rashid floats this one full and wider outside the off stump. Afif Hossain feels for the ball with no real conviction and gets a faint edge to the keeper. Jos Buttler moves well to his left and holds onto the ball and Bangladesh are now six down.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This has been driven beautifully! Adil Rashid flights this full and outside the off stump. Afif Hossain strokes this to deep cover for four runs.
Goes full and outside the off stump, Afif Hossain knocks this straight to point.
Short once again and going down leg. Afif Hossain misses his clip and the ball goes off his thigh pad onto the stumps but does no dislodge the bails.
Adil Rashid bowls this short and on a leg stump line. Afif Hossain rocks back and dabs this towards mid-wicket.
Delivers this onto the pads on a good length. Afif Hossain misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards square leg for a leg bye.
Slightly short once again and outside the off stump. Afif Hossain pulls this towards mid-wicket.
Delivers this one on a good length and in line with the stumps. Mahmudullah knocks this back past the bowler for one.
This is bowled slightly short as well and outside the off stump. Afif Hossain cuts this late to deep backward point and takes one.
Saqib Mahmood bowls this back of a length and outside the off stump. Afif Hossain gives the bowler the charge but miscues his pull into the leg side.
Saqib Mahmood bowls this on a good length and just outside the off pole. Afif Hossain dabs this towards mid on.

Drinks break! 174 needed off just 96 balls and with only 5 wickets in hand, Bangladesh will need more than a miracle to level the series. Shakib Al Hasan batted well in the middle phase but England were able to dismiss Shakib and Tamim Iqbal in order to stay in pole position. Mahmudullah and Afif Hossain are doing well to muster up runs against the English spinners but they need to step on the gas at the earliest. Also, Saqib Mahmood is brought back into the attack.
A tad short and wide, cut away to point for one.

Well fielded! Tosses it up full and around off, Afif Hossain sweeps it hard and along the ground behind square leg. Dawid Malan from deep square leg sprints to his right and dives in to make the stop. They take two runs.
Flatter one turning into the stumps, worked away to square leg.
Tossed up around off, Mahmudullah slog-sweeps it flat and hard to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, pushed out onto the off side for a quick single.
On off stump, Afif Hossain pushes it to mid off.
Flatter one on the stumps, this is chopped off the back foot to deep cover for one.
This is short once again and outside off. Afif Hossain mistimes his shot into the off side.
SIX! What an outstanding shot! Afif Hossain finally showing some intention here! Moeen Ali bowls this at the stumps on a fuller length. Afif Hossain tonks this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Flights this one full and outside off. Afif Hossain pushes at this and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Continues to bowl short and outside off. Afif Hossain cuts this to deep point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Moeen Ali bowls this short and fires this into the stumps. Afif Hossain goes deep in the crease and cuts this really late. The ball races to the deep backward point fence for four runs.
This is short as well and outside off. Mahmudullah rocks back and mistimes his cut shot to cover.
Loops this one full and outside off. Afif Hossain pushes this into cover and sets off for a single. He is off the mark on his 12th delivery!
Short and outside off. Mahmudullah cuts this to deep point for a single.
Flights this full and outside off. Mahmudullah dabs this into the off side.
This is short and into the stumps. Mahmudullah tucks this towards mid wicket.
FOUR! Bangladesh need many more of these! Afif Hossain flights this full and outside off, Mahmudullah goes hard at the ball and slices it towards deep point for four runs.
Flights this full and outside off. Afif Hossain defends this to cover.
Goes full once again and into the stumps. Mahmudullah hits this to long on for a run.
Loops this full and spinning down leg. Mahmudullah misses and the ball goes into the leg side off his pads.
Sightly short and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah cuts this straight to short third man. Dot balls piling up.
Tosses this full as well and attacks the stumps. Mahmudullah flicks this to the mid-wicket fielder.
Moeen Ali flights this one full and into the stumps. Mahmudullah clips this towards mid-wicket.
Short once again and outside the off pole. Afif Hossain miscues his pull to mid on. Just one run from the over.
Bowls this one short and outside the off stump. Afif Hossain rocks back and mistimes his shot to the mid off fielder.
Tosses this one full as well and outside the off stump. Afif Hossain knocks this back to the bowler.
Goes full and in line with the stumps spinning down leg side. Afif Hossain looks to defend but misses and the ball lobs into the leg side off his pads.
Loops this one full and outside the off stump. Afif Hossain defends this one solidly.
Adil Rashid bowls this short and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah pulls this straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses this outside the off stump on a fuller length. Afif Hossain strokes this straight to the cover fielder.
Flights this one full and in line with the stumps. Afif Hossain knocks this back to the bowler.

FOUR LEG BYES! Some free runs gifted by Moeen Ali! He strays down leg on a fuller length. Afif Hossain looks to flick this but misses and the ball skims off his pads towards third man for four extra runs.
Slightly short this time and outside the off stump. Afif Hossain whips this straight to mid-wicket.
Flights this one beautifully on a fuller length and wider outside off. Afif Hossain looks to go through the line of the ball but gets beaten by some vicious turn.
Mahmudullah floats this one full and just outside the off pole. Mahmudullah works this down to long on for one.
Afif Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The pressure has finally got to Shakib Al Hasan and he departs in the quest to accelerate! Adil Rashid flights this one full and outside the off stump tempting the batter to go after him. Shakib Al Hasan makes room to the leg side and looks to go aerial but does not connect this cleanly. The ball floats into the air and goes to the left of mid off. Sam Curran makes no mistake grabbing hold of this and Bangladesh have now lost half their side. A big wicket for the visitors.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls this short and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah cuts this towards deep backward point and takes a single.
Tempting the batter! Flights it up really full and around off. Mahmudullah hangs deep and just tries to whack it over extra cover. The ball though turns away and beats the outside edge.
Shorter again and on middle, Mahmudullah goes on the back foot to defend.
A bit shorter and on middle and leg, kept out by Mahmudullah.
Tossed up on the stumps, Shakib Al Hasan slogs it away behind square leg and picks up a single.
Nagging length around off, chopped to point for a run.
Around off stump, pushed away to wide mid on for a quick single.
Fuller and on the stumps, worked away to mid-wicket.
Flatter again, on the pads, this is worked away behind square on the leg side for one.
Flatter delivery, angled into middle, Shakib Al Hasan pushes it back to the bowler.
Moeen Ali bowls this short and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah rocks back and punches this down to long on for a run.
Strays onto the pads on a fuller length. Mahmudullah clips this towards deep backward square leg and takes a single to keep strike.
Flights this full and outside off. Mahmudullah pushes at this and gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! A streaky boundary but they all count! Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah goes hard at the ball and gets an outside edge towards third man for four runs.
Floated full and outside off. Mahmudullah dabs this towards point.
Flighted full and outside off. Shakib Al Hasan sweeps this to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Slightly short and outside off. Mahmudullah punches this to deep point for a single.
A flighted delivery bowled full and at the stumps. Shakib Al Hasan clears his front foot out of the way and mishits this back to the bowler.
Bowls this one slightly short and outside the off stump. Shakib Al Hasan cuts this straight to the point fielder.
Moeen Ali bowls this full and in the pads. Mahmudullah tucks this to deep square leg for a single.
Loops his one full as well and outside off. Mahmudullah dabs this to the left of the bowler.
Floats this one full and outside the off pole. Mahmudullah looks to reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Moeen Ali bowls this short and in line with the stumps. Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to the left of mid on and takes a run.
Tosses this one full as well and outside off. Shakib Al Hasan sweeps this uppishly towards deep square leg and takes one to keep strike.

FOUR! Two boundaries in a row and brings up the FIFTY for Shakib Al Hasan! Adil Rashid floats this one full and outside the off stump. Shakib Al Hasan gets his front foot forward and creams this towards deep cover for four runs.

FOUR! Loose delivery from Adil Rashid and Shakib Al Hasan makes the most of it! Adil Rashid bowls this short and outside the off stump. Shakib Al Hasan slaps this towards deep point and collects four runs.
A tad bit short once again and outside the off pole. Mahmudullah punches this towards deep cover-point and takes a single.
Flights this one full and outside leg. Mahmudullah flicks this towards mid-wicket.
Adil Rashid begins with a short ball bowled at the stumps. Shakib Al Hasan goes deep in the crease and clips this towards deep square leg for one.
Adil Rashid is brought into the attack now.
Maiden over for Moeen Ali! he bowls this full and wider outside off. Mahmudullah looks to play this into the off side but misses.
Make that five! Short once again and just outside the off pole. Mahmudullah goes back in the crease and cuts this straight to short third man.
Four dot balls now. Moeen Ali bowls this short and going down leg. Mahmudullah is unable to put this away and the ball rolls to short fine leg.
Tosses this one full and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah knocks this towards cover.
BEATEN! Moeen Ali gets this one tho skid through from a fuller length and outside off. Mahmudullah pushes at this and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Moeen Ali floats this one full and outside the off stump. Mahmudullah knocks this back to the bowler.
Shorter and turning a long way away from the off stump, Shakib Al Hasan stays back and chops it behind point.
LEG BYE! A bit shorter and turning in from the off stump, Mahmudullah looks to sweep it fine but gets it off the forearm and down to short fine leg for a leg bye.
Tossed up on a length and around off, Mahmudullah keeps it out off the front foot.
Around middle and leg, flicked away toward mid-wicket for an easy single.
Shorter and turning in from well outside off, Mahmudullah dabs it down off the back foot toward backward point and scampers across for a quick single.
FOUR! Flighted delivery, turning in a long way from outside off. Mahmudullah gets a big stride in and sweeps it hard into the square leg fence.
On the stumps, Shakib Al Hasan watchfully keeps it out.
Flatter one, turning in sharply from around off. Mahmudullah looks to defend off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the leg side and gets off the mark with a single.
Mahmudullah makes his way out to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! The scoreboard pressure has finally got to Tamim Iqbal and he holes out. Moeen Ali tosses this one up around middle and leg. Tamim dances down the track and looks to loft it inside-out. The ball is skied really high and toward wide long off. James Vince from long off moves to his right and keeps his eyes on the ball to take a solid catch. The skipper departs and Bangladesh are now 4 down.
Commentary.Howout: c James Vince b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, pushed out to cover for one.

Overthrows! Flatter and around off, this is nudged away past first slip for a quick single. Dawid Malan there fires in a wide throw at the bowler's end and allows the batters to come back for the second.
Full and outside off, this is driven square of the wicket to deep point for one.
Flatter one around off, this is tapped away to point.
FOUR! Adding insult to injury! Floated up on leg stump, Shakib Al Hasan clears the front leg and slogs it away in front of mid-wicket for a boundary.

A huge cheer from the crowd as the onfield decision is reversed! Will Jacks tosses it up nicely around middle and off. Shakib Al Hasan gets on one knee looking to sweep but misses and the ball turns away to hit the pads. There is an appeal for LBW and the finger is raised! Shakib Al Hasan has taken the review but this one looks pretty straight. The UltraEdge is checked first and shows that the ball just took the underside of the glove before hitting the pads and Shakib is a relieved man.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Tamim Iqbal steps out and looks to go inside-out but mistimes it over cover for only a single.
Short and wide, Shakib Al Hasan misses out and lets out a huge grunt as well. This is bowled around off, Shakib backs away and cuts it straight to deep point for one.
Slower and shorter on off stump, Shakib Al Hasan shuffles across and paddles it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Gives it a bit more air and bowls it full outside off, Tamim Iqbal gets on the front foot and blocks it out in front of point.
Full and around off, pushed out on the off side.
Bowls it fuller and around middle, Tamim Iqbal gets an inside edge toward square leg.
This is angled into middle and leg, Tamim Iqbal defends it out.
Flatter and around off, cut away to point for a quick single.

FOUR BYES! Through everything! A bit shorter and around off, Shakib Al Hasan misses the sweep and the ball turns away sharply. Jos Buttler is well beaten and the diving fielder from first slip can't reach it either. The ball rolls away into the third man fence.
Moeen Ali to have a bowl now.
Floats it up around middle, Tamim Iqbal strides forward and makes the block.
Shortens the length and looks to turn it away around off, Tamim Iqbal taps it toward cover-point.
Full and outside off, driven crisply through extra cover for one.
Floated up on the stumps, Shakib Al Hasan sweeps it off the top edge of the bat and over backward square leg. They hustle back for two runs.
Flatter and outside off, cut away straight to short third man.
Tossed up on off stump, Shakib Al Hasan looks for the reverse sweep but mistimes it toward cover.
A bumper to end as this is banged in over middle and leg, angling in. Tamim Iqbal does well to duck under it.
Pitches it up now at 144 clicks and around off, reversing just a bit. Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone.
Another pacy short ball over off stump, Tamim Iqbal sways his head away from the line of the ball.

Ouch, that must have hurt! A bit of hostility here from Mark Wood as he serves a pacy short ball right at the body. Tamim Iqbal looks to duck under it but the ball just hurries on and hits him around the shoulder. Tamim though just shrugs it off.
Gets a hand on it! Short and wide, Shakib Al Hasan slaps it hard and to the right of the man at point who gets a hand on it and keeps it down to a single.
Bowled from around the stumps, on a good length and angled into middle. Shakib Al Hasan nudges it down to short third man.
Looped up on off stump, Tamim Iqbal keeps it out.
Floated up full and around off, Tamim Iqbal edges it down with soft hands and past the fielder at short third man for a couple of runs.
This is tossed up a bit fuller and around off, Tamim strokes it away to cover.
Flighted again around off, Tamim Iqbal defends it off the front foot.
Around off stump, Shakib Al Hasan sweeps it away behind square leg and turns the strike over.
Lovely delivery! Flights it up full and around off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to block but just gets completely beaten by the turn and bounce.

Drinks break! This has been a decent recovery from Bangladesh but with 263 runs still needed off just 35 overs, England are firmly in command here. Sam Curran gave the visitors a perfect start as he sent back 3 out of the top 4 batters and had the hosts reeling at 9/3. Since then though, the experienced pair of Tamim Iqbal and Shakib Al Hasan has put on a gritty stand and they will now look to just keep taling the game as deep as possible.
Comes from around the wicket now and angles in a shortish delivery from around off. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and just guides it down to third man for a single.
Short of a length on the body, Tamim Iqbal works it away toward square leg and picks up a run.
Hard length over middle, Tamim blocks it out.
WIDE! Banged in short and over middle but it is just a bit too short and Tamim Iqbal ducks under it with ease.
Short again, around off, Tamim Iqbal hops and keeps it down on the off side.
Pacy delivery, banged in short and over middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan looks to take it on but gets hurried and mistimes the pull shot in front of square leg for a run.
Back of a length and around the hips, this is worked away through square leg for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Quicker and shorter close to the off stump, Shakib Al Hasan cuts it really late and gets it into the third man fence for a boundary.

A half-hearted appeal and nothing more. Will Jacks gives it a nice bit of flight and bowls it around off stump. Shakib Al Hasan looks to open up the off side and go over covers but the ball turns and beats the bat by a long way. Jos Buttler whips off the bails and appeals for a stumping. The umpires do go upstairs but the replays show that Shakib has his back leg planted inside the crease.
This is angled into the pads, Shakib nudges it onto the leg side.
Flighted delivery around middle, Tamim Iqbal turns it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off stump, Tamim Iqbal blocks it out.
Nagging length outside off, Shakib looks to hang back and cut but ends up just dabbing it toward backward point.
Full and around off, Shakib Al Hasan drills it straight to mid off.
Back of a length and around the hips at 151.2 clicks. Tamim Iqbal tucks it toward deep square leg for one more.
Pitches this one up around the leg stump, Shakib Al Hasan looks to work it leg side but gets a leading edge that goes through cover and they get a single.
Hard length again over the off stump, Shakib stays back and keeps it down on the deck.
Good running! Bowled on a hard length at over 146 clicks, Shakib hops and works it away with soft hands through square leg. Shakib calls for two and races back for it as well.
On a good length over middle and leg, Tamim Iqbal tucks it away past square leg for an easy single.
On off stump, pushed away onto the off side for a single.
Beaten! Flighted delivery, full and on off stump, Tamim Iqbal looks to block but the ball grips and turns away sharply past the outside edge.
Bowls this flatter and fires it into middle, Iqbal keeps it out.
Way too short and outside off, Shakib misses out as he taps it to deep point for just a single.
Nicely bowled! A bit of drift in from outside off, Shakib looks to push at it off the front foot but the ball turns away and beats the outside edge.
Starts off with a shortish ball well wide of the off stump. Shakib Al Hasan looks to cut but is well beaten.
Will Jacks to roll his arm over.
On a length and slanted across the left-hander, Tamim Iqbal shoulders arms at it.
Pitched up on off stump, Tamim defends it to short cover.
Short again at 144 clicks, Shakib works it off his hips down to fine leg for one more.
Bangs it in short at over 143 clicks and around middle and leg. Tamim Iqbal hops and nudges it down in front of mid-wicket for a quick single.
Fullish length around off, this is heaved away off the toe end of the bat onto the leg side for one.
Mark Wood comes into the attack and starts with a length ball around the top of off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to defend but is taken aback by the extra bounce and gets hit on the gloves.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 players outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Back of a length outside off, Shakib Al Hasan taps this to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Tamim Iqbal clips this to square leg for a single.
On a length around off, Tamim Iqbal guides this straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Lucky escape for the Bangladesh skipper. Full and wide outside off, Tamim Iqbal slashes hard at this and it edges past the vacant second slip for a boundary.
Back of a length on top of off, Tamim Iqbal punches this back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, Tamim Iqbal defends this in front for no run.
Halt! Saqib Mahmood is not happy with the landing area. The groundsman comes out with the hammer and levels it. We are ready to go now.
On a length and on off, Shakib Al Hasan defends this in front.
Short-pitched delivery body bound, Shakib Al Hasan ducks underneath this.
On a length outside off, Tamim Iqbal taps this with softer hands at point and runs a single.
Fuller around pads, Shakib Al Hasan flicks this to square leg for a single. Jason Roy saves a certain boundary here. Really good fielding by England here.
Full and wide of off, Shakib Al Hasan slices this over the fielder at point for a couple of runs. This was boundary bound but Philip Salt saves a couple for his team with a brilliant diving effort.
On a length around middle, Tamim Iqbal pushes this to short mid-wicket and runs for this. Sam Curran has overstepped here. Free hit upcoming.
Fuller one pitching on off and shaping away from Tamim Iqbal , he defends this well.
Back of a length around off, Tamim Iqbal pushes this with soft hands to extra cover and runs for this.
Fuller around pads, Tamim Iqbal flicks this to square leg for no run.
Back of a length around middle, Tamim Iqbal defends this off his back foot for no run.
FOUR! Vintage Tamim Iqbal. Fuller around pads, Tamim Iqbal drives this past the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
On a length on off, Shakib Al Hasan dabs this near the square and they steal a single.
Back of a length around off, Shakib Al Hasan guides this to point for no run.
On a length in middle, Tamim Iqbal pulls this short of Roy at square leg.
On a length bang in middle, Shakib Al Hasan works this wide of the fielder at square leg for a single.
On a length around middle and leg, Shakib Al Hasan nudges this to square leg for nothing.
Fuller and on pads, Tamim Iqbal flicks this to deep square leg for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Tamim Iqbal chips this over the head of Curran for a couple toward long off.
On a length around off, Tamim Iqbal tentatively defends this to the on side.
Back of a length around pads, Tamim Iqbal deflects this off his pads to short fine leg for a single. Leg byes signaled.
On a length angling away with the arm, Tamim Iqbal strides forward to block this but gets beaten on his outside edge.
Back of a length around pads, Shakib Al Hasan tucks this to short fine leg for a single.
Back of a length around off, Shakib Al Hasan taps this to second slip on a couple of bounces.
On a length on top of middle, Shakib Al Hasan defends this to the on side.
Full and on middle, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to extra cover for no run.
A maiden over! This is again on a good length and outside off, Tamim Iqbal deliberately plays inside the line and lets it go to the keeper.
Simliar to the previous delivery, outside off, nips away, Tamim Iqbal is not interested in playing that.
Length again and around off, Tamim Iqbal sways his bat away from it and plays inside the line.
Goes fuller this time, on off, Tamim Iqbal drives it towards mid off.
BEATEN! This is on a hard length and just around off, shaping away, Tamim Iqbal looks to defend it, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and on middle, Tamim Iqbal works it off the inner half towards square leg.
Short of a length and on off, Shakib Al Hasan bunts it onto the off side.
This is on a good length and on the sixth stump line, angling away, Shakib Al Hasan decides to not play it.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Saqib Mahmood pitches this one up, on off, Shakib Al Hasan waits for it and drives it firmly under his eyes through covers for a glorious boundary.
Back of a length and on off, Shakib Al Hasan dabs it towards point.
Full again and around off, Shakib Al Hasan drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Full and outside off, angling away, Shakib Al Hasan throws his bat at it, but misses it completely.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is full and around leg, Tamim Iqbal moves across a bit and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length and outside off, Tamim Iqbal offers no shot at it.
On a length and on middle, Shakib Al Hasan tries to keep it out, but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Full and on middle, shaping away, Shakib Al Hasan knocks it towards mid on.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out in the middle and joins skipper Tamim Iqbal.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sam Curran sets up Mushfiqur Rahim perfectly here! A huge appeal for caught behind, but turned down. Jos Buttler takes the review anyways. Sam Curran lands this on a hard length and around off, shaping away this time after shaping in on the last two deliveries, Mushfiqur Rahim tries to push it away from his body, but gets the slightest of edges back towards the keeper where Jos Buttler takes a comfortable catch. He is quite convinced about this and he is absolutely right as UltraEdge confirms the edge. The on-field decision is changed and Bangladesh lose their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a good length and on off, shaping in, Mushfiqur Rahim watchfully blocks it out towards short covers.
Length again and on off, Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone.
Good comeback from Saqib Mahmood! He bowls this on a hard length and around off, angling away, Tamim Iqbal looks to play at it, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Good shot! Saqib Mahmood serves this full and around off, Tamim Iqbal leans on and drives it sweetly through covers for a boundary.
On a length and on off, Tamim Iqbal blocks it out.
Pulls his length back a bit, on off, Mushfiqur Rahim steers it through backward point for a single.
Saqib Mahmood starts with a full delivery, on off, Mushfiqur Rahim knocks it towards covers.
Saqib Mahmood will accompany Sam Curran in attack from the other end.

No hat-trick for Sam Curran! He tries for the yorker, but serves a full toss, on off, Mushfiqur Rahim drives it through covers as the fielder chases it down and slides to keep it inside. Three runs taken!
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out to face the hat-trick delivery.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sam Curran with the double whammy here! He sends back Najmul Hossain Shanto for a golen duck too. This is on a good length and around off, shaping away, Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to have a poke at it, but the movement away takes the outside edge and flies towards the keeper where Jos Buttler makes no mistake. Bangladesh in a spot of bother now and Sam Curran is on a hat-trick.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Najmul Hossain Shanto walks out at no. 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Sam Curran draws first blood! Litton Das goes without troubling the scorers. This is full again and outside off, Litton Das reaches for it to drive it away, but without much footwork. As a result he slices it up in the air towards point where Jason Roy pouches it safely. A huge blow for Bangladesh!
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Tamim Iqbal and Bangladesh are underway! This is much fuller and on the pads, Tamim Iqbal tickles it towards fine leg for a single.
This is on a hard length and on off, nips away, Tamim Iqbal gets squared up and the ball goes off his leading edge towards point.
Sam Curran starts with a good-length delivery, on off, shaping away a bit, Tamim Iqbal blocks it out down the pitch.
